tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron me'i don yang dag par bsdus pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rab byung sogs bsdoms bcu gnyis kyis bsgyur 'das zla bsre// 'og tu rir bcas zung bsgyur mda' ros rnyed steng sbyin// gsum dbus gcig bsre sos bsgyur bcu gnyis sbyin 'og tu// gnyis bsgyur ris dbye lhag ma bcus bsgyur gcig steng phab// drug cur sbyangs lhag srang thob dbugs nas sbyangs drug cus// phyed lhag chu tshod thob pa steng bsre ris lhag gza'i// gnyis 'og bco brgyad bsres nas dus nyis phyed lhag cha// steng zung bsgyur la gsum bcas nor bsres nyer brgyad kyis lhag tshogs// gsum dbus drag bsgyur 'og tu brgyad sbyin so dgus lhag /drug cus bsgyur la so dgus thob pas steng nas gcig /drug cus sbyangs lhag srang dbugs drug cu nor// sbyangs nas drug cus lhag dbugs steng zung bsnun par nor// sbyin nas nyer bdun gyis lhag rgyu skar nges pa'o// zla dag don bzhi byin nas sum cus bsgyur tshes bsre// drug stong dgu brgyas phyed lhag nyer bdun la sogs kyis// bsgyur rnyed rnams kyis phyed dag longs spyod gzung*// zla dag sum cus bsgyur la tshes bsre gsum bkod la// gnyis dang nyi shu bdun sbyangs drug brgya don gsum bsre// bdun brgya bdun gyis thob dbugs byin nas re bzhi thob// stong 'phrog res gza' dang bstun gsal ba'i zhag /dmar phyir nyis brgya so bdun byin nas drug /brgya brgya bcu bdun dbye ba lhag phyir brgya yis bsgyur// nyis stong bdun brgya bcu drug bsres nas ni// brgyad stong bdun brgya go bdun gyis bgo phur phyir stong brgya re dgu bsre// bzhi stong sum brgya so gnyis kyis dbye dkar phyir bcu bsnun bdun brgya re gsum sbyin// nyis stong nyis brgya zhe bdun gyis dbye dal phyir nyis stong don lnga bris nas ni// khri phrag bdun brgya re drug gis phye dag rnams longs spyod bya// longs spyod gsum dbus dmar phyir dbu dang sum cu phur bcu gnyis// spen pa bco brgyad lhag phyir nyi mar bcu drug dang*// sum cu dkar phyir drug sbyar rim pas yin min dpyad// skar lhag drug cus bsgyur bsre brgya dang so lngas dbye// thob pa dal rkang bzung zhing snga phyi dpyad la des// lhag skar nyi dang gzhan gyi longs spyod dag la ni// rim min sbyin zhing rim pa sbyangs ba dal ba dag pa'o// myur phyir dal gsum dmar phur spen pa'i gcig gi nyi mas sbyangs// lhag skar longs spyod sbyangs shing kun gyis lhag mas myur rkang bzung*// snga phyir dpyad nas dal bar min dor rim pa nor// myur bar dag pa yin te gza' rnams rnam par dpyad dus gsal ba'i sgron ma'i don yang dag par bsdus pa rdzogs so//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
